newsitem.title: UK: UK stocks open lower, Wall Street weakness weighs.
newsitem.headline: UK stocks open lower, Wall Street weakness weighs.

text.p: UK blue chips were subject to a predictable mark down on Tuesday following Wall Street's 49-point slide overnight but dealers believe the FTSE's decline will be shortlived.
"We're not seeing a lot of selling. Market makers will cut prices until the buyers return," one senior dealer said. "If Wall Street has a good start later today we could end the day a bit better."
The FTSE 100, which on Monday finished just 0.1 point below its record close of 4,307.8 set last Friday, was down 10.1 points at 4,297.6 by 0837 GMT.
